criteria.evidence: probe v12 (schema a8-speed/12), two independent channels over the same definitional event (CT 296 -> first >= 998 on battle-start.ss0): (a) traced channel counts exact frames with start CT verified == 296 at stop 1, end >= 998 at the last stop, zero PC anomalies, every cont/stop timestamped; (b) free-run channel brackets duration in wall time from timestamped cont/read windows (a served read implicitly halts the core, only 'c' resumes it - DE-029; reply pairing proven by drain_paired - DE-028), start and end samples retained with absolute epochs, end detected by direct >=998 read or the wrap signature. fps = N/D with N bracketed by pooled traced observations (default 1126-1190, vsync1 1123-1162 frames). Result: default 52.5-58.0 fps = 0.88-0.97x GBA nominal; videoSync=1 52.2-56.3 fps = 0.87-0.94x. No Lua console, no CT-rate baseline, no hardcoded prediction.
criteria.limitation: the >=998 state dwells ~1 frame and is not directly pollable at 0.15 s cadence, so free-run end detection uses the wrap signature; the duration bracket (~0.2 s wide on ~21 s) and the pooled N jitter (~5%) are carried into the published fps bracket rather than hidden

criteria.evidence: v12: two traced boots per mode (default N 1190/1190, spread 0%; vsync1 1162/1123, spread 3.4%) and two free-run boots per mode with OVERLAPPING per-boot fps brackets (default 54.3-58.0 and 52.5-56.0; vsync1 52.2-54.6 and 53.8-56.3), start CT = 296 in all four free-run boots, 131-140 timestamped polls each. criteria.evidence: Moot by measurement: there is exactly one speed (0.87-0.97x nominal, v12) and execution stops with the run - the detach law (no stub client = paused) IS the stop primitive; nothing to restore, nothing left running at a different speed.

Round-9/10 reconciliation (docs/autobattle-speed.md, docs/player-ai-control.md): the A8 detach law means 'leave-running' alone hands over a PAUSED game - a player/agent continuation requires a monitoring client attached (monitor pattern, one connection, interrupt/read/cont per observation). The C3 manual layer proves exactly this loop live (c3-live-b2: leg 1 pause+handoff, window-only manual input, leg 2 resume to completion), and a8-resp2 demonstrates the same pause-plus-left-running handoff with durable artifacts. An unassisted no-software session is impossible under the law and is not claimed; window-input-while-detached was not separately exercised (the core is not stepping) and is recorded as covered by the law, not by a dedicated test.

conclusion: Investigation complete and calibrated: the runner runs at 0.87-0.97x GBA nominal on this host (NOT accelerated - the earlier always-accelerated reading is refuted), the rate is stable and measured from timestamped two-channel evidence with no baseline folklore, and no tested mechanism provides selectable speed. Product acceptance (normal/accelerated selection + two-speed equivalence) remains open by evidence, not by wording.
